split: Enumerate 3/4/5-symptom sets; exclude all v1 and v2 symptom-set IDs, sort by SHA256('v4-planner:'+base_id). First 320 base sets train, next 64 validation, next 128 test. Each receives an unconstrained budget-8 profile and a deterministic engineering constraint profile with budget 4, two excluded herbs and two requested incompatible pairs. Split by base symptom set, never by profile. No clinical patient or pharmacological contraindication claim for generated requests.
objective: Unchanged v1/v2 evidence utility: normalized .65 symptom + .30 target + .05 PPI coverage minus .02 per herb. Affiliation remains association, not measured affinity or efficacy.
environment: STOP is explicit, all hard-feasible useful actions allowed including temporarily nonpositive gain. State includes complete requested-pair matrix and remaining budget. Existing production environment is not overwritten.
architecture: Shared action scorer with full-state context (16 dimensions), candidate marginal coverage features, action identity and pair row. Residual KAN uses 16 hidden cubic-spline units; MLP uses 192 hidden units for approximate actor parameter matching. Common separate 64-unit critic. Initial residual output zero. KAN without prior removes the explicit additive marginal-gain path but retains the same observable features.
teacher: Exact best feasible final utility for each available first action, computed only for training requests. States from greedy and one exact-set trajectory plus two deterministic feasible off-policy subsets. Learn centered action values and soft teacher distribution; do not label actions merely by greedy imitation.
selection: Mean validation final utility across both fixed profiles; include initial policy, warm-only policy and PPO snapshots. First best wins ties within 1e-8. Freeze all nine selected/warm checkpoints and source hashes before test evaluation. Publish selected iteration and all validation curves.
baselines: best verified objective of learned rollout and greedy, explicitly identified as a hybrid safeguard
metrics: Raw network minus greedy paired query bootstrap and sign-flip test with Holm correction
Optimality gap and exact-optimum hit count
Hard constraint violations and STOP behavior
Full rollout wall time including state features
limits: Engineered evidence-retrieval queries, not clinical cases
New task distribution and hard-only action mask differ from earlier rounds; no direct cross-round score subtraction
Guarded improvement is attributable to verified candidate comparison, not proof of KAN superiority
Exact teachers use the same known graph; this tests planning compression, not discovering clinical knowledge
Only 19 candidate herbs, so strong classical solvers can remain preferable
